featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very disappointing experience at this bookstore. The visit felt like a complete waste of time. The person handling this shop has no mercy about the customer. I had a very bad experience of this shop. I visited this shop first time and given order for engineering books. The shop owner note down my number and promised to call once book arrived. But he fail to do his promise.
A very bad experience that he never picked up call which is given on his card.

But the fact is that books was there in his shop but he didn't inform me to come and collect. Today I went to check again ( 5th times) he said it is come and I tried paying through online but due to his bank server problem the payment not done. featured_reviews.name: Urvi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fondest childhood memories of seeing faraway worlds (real and imaginary) through pages of endless books at Roxy Library <3
My taste in books has kept evolving and expanding over the years and the library has had me covered throughout.
~Kudos to Bharat uncle for frequent new and exciting additions to their book collection!~

Been a member here for over 3 decades and the new revamp took my breath away (yes, not-so-secret bibliophile here)
Whether you are a bookworm or new to reading, Roxy is a must visit.

P.S. they also have a reading nook and serve refreshments.

featured_reviews.review_text:

The staff is helpful and always ready to guide kids. A great place for both fun and learning together.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Kudos to Roxy, the best place for all things books n toys in Mulund West, n kudos to the ace quality library experience n friendly service of all staff :-)

featured_reviews.name: Pawan Thapa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Raj Book Depot in Bhandup West is a delightful find for anyone passionate about books. Located at D/5, Ishwar Nagar, near the Post Office on Shine Marg, it's a cozy store that offers a wide range of books catering to various interests.
Instagram
magicpin
+1
Dukaan
+1

The store boasts an impressive collection, from academic textbooks to novels and children's literature. What sets it apart is its curated selection of second-hand books, allowing readers to discover rare and timeless classics at affordable prices.
Instagram

The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to assist in finding the book you're looking for or recommending new reads based on your preferences. Their passion for books is evident, making the shopping experience personal and enjoyable.

In addition to physical books, Raj Book Depot has embraced the digital age with an online store, making it convenient for customers to browse and purchase books from the comfort of their homes.
Dukaan

Open daily from 8 AM to 8 PM, it's a must-visit for book enthusiasts in the area. Whether you're a student, a casual reader, or someone looking to rekindle their love for reading, Raj Book Depot has something for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Rudra Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jagdish Book Depot is located near Bhandup railway station, opposite UBS School. It’s a reliable place for students and readers to find a wide range of books at reasonable prices. They offer textbooks for various courses such as 12th Commerce, B.Com, B.Sc, BBA, M.Com, BAF, and similar programs, available in both new and second-hand options.

Apart from academic books, the store also has a good collection of finance, fiction, autobiographies, self-growth, and communication-related books. You can also exchange or return your old books and get money back or buy new ones by paying a small difference.

Overall, Jagdish Book Depot is a convenient and affordable option for students and book lovers near Bhandup.
